entities.summary: Tadashi Kawamata (b. 1953-07-24, Mikasa) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Mikasa and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, painters & sculptors, asia.
